text:
emma_ae: Kicking off Galileo POC perf + security thread. Customer acceptance: 700 qps sustained, p95 < 140ms, show encryption impact and a multicandidate routing fallback test. Need a short runbook, smoke numbers, and an hourly POC estimate.
ryan_eng: Suggest running two model variants: rdx-3b-quant (cost-optimized) and rdx-6b-fp16 (latency headroom). We'll do A/B routing 50/50 and a fallback path to rdx-3b if 6b latency spikes. Payloads ~280 tokens in / 110 out.
lucy_sre: Cluster sizing: start with 12 nodes for 700 qps (6b headroom), autoscale off for deterministic POC. Warmup: 12m prefix & KV priming. Steady-state 35m, then a 7m 950 qps spike to validate fallback.
tom_sec: KMS note: we'll show three modes: none, envelope-cached, and strict-unwrap-every-request. Also include key-rotation and audit trail snippet for their security questionnaire.
emma_ae: Can you paste a compact run command I can forward and what metrics we'll capture?
ryan_eng: Vegeta example (A/B):
```
# split traffic on generator side, two target endpoints
vegeta attack -rate=350 -duration=35m -targets=rdx6b.txt > rdx6b.bin &
vegeta attack -rate=350 -duration=35m -targets=rdx3b.txt > rdx3b.bin
vegeta report -type='hist[0,50,100,150,300,500,1000]' rdx6b.bin rdx3b.bin > run-report.txt
```
Capture: p50/p90/p95/p99, server GPU util, CPU offload, kernel preempt metrics, KV cache hit rate, and end-to-end token/sec. We'll also collect traces for any requests >500ms.
perf-bot: perf-job-galileo-4399999000 started on ded-cluster-9.
lucy_sre: Quick smoke (warm cache): rdx-3b p95 ~125ms, rdx-6b p95 ~105ms, A/B combined p95 ~115ms. With envelope-cache p95 ~135ms combined. Strict unwrap p95 ~170ms. p99s: 3b=260ms, 6b=210ms. Throughput stable at 700 qps.
tom_sec: Draft security blurb for questionnaire: "Customer CMKs remain in their KMS. Redwood performs envelope encryption: ephemeral envelope keys are generated per-node and cached for performance. Unwrap operations use customer KMS; all unwrap/key-use events are logged and can be forwarded to customer's audit endpoint (CloudTrail/Splunk). Envelope keys rotate every 24h by default; CMK rotations follow customer KMS policy. For FIPS/HSM requirements we support CloudHSM/Azure Dedicated HSM and can provide attestation artifacts on request."
emma_ae: Can someone convert perf delta into cost impact? They want $/1M tokens and POC hourly estimate.
lucy_sre: Node price example $3.00/hr -> 12 nodes = $36/hr. Baseline compute token cost ~ $1.00 per 1M tokens. Envelope-cache overhead ~+15% -> ~+$0.15 per 1M tokens. Strict unwrap ~+40% -> ~+$0.40 per 1M tokens (includes added KMS egress/latency + cpu overhead). I'll add a short table for the AE.
ryan_eng: Note on fallback: when 6b latency > 200ms for >10s, routing falls back to 3b; observed transition adds ~30-60ms for affected requests while caches warm on the fallback model. We'll capture that in run-report.
perf-bot: perf-job-galileo-4399999000 completed. Artifacts: s3://perf-artifacts/galileo/4399999000/{vegeta_rdx6b.bin,vegeta_rdx3b.bin,run-report.html,gpu-cpu-metrics.tar.gz}
emma_ae: Action items: ryan upload abridged run-report + PNG graphs; lucy finalize POC hourly quote and node config; tom paste security blurb into the questionnaire and confirm log-forward steps. I'll package and send once artifacts land.
ryan_eng: Warmup script used: `./tools/warm_prefix.py --prefixes 15000 --clients 30 --duration 12m`
lucy_sre: Cluster config note: `ENVELOPE_CACHE_TTL=3600` for cached runs; `KMS_STRICT_UNWRAP=true` for strict path.
tom_sec: For audit forwarding we configured an S3 sink + Kinesis stream to their Splunk instance in the POC. I'll export the config snippet if they need it.
emma_ae: Great work team. Will ping if they ask for multi-region failover or HSM attestation docs. :thumbsup:
